item.title: Isozyme-Specific Inhibition of GSK-3 Reveals Distinct Cellular Responses in Huntington's Disease Fibroblasts.
item.description:
Scan · Journal of neurochemistry · section: Lysosomes, Endosomes & Lysosomal Stress/Repair · source: Primary / trusted · fits the Lysosomes, Endosomes & Lysosomal Stress/Repair definition: moderate
Although inhibition of either isozyme suppressed mTORC1 signaling, selective GSK-3β inhibition elicited broader cellular responses, including altered oxidative stress signaling, increased expression of proteins associated with mitochondrial fission, enhanced lysosomal activity, and mitophagy, together with lysosomal redistribution and increased α-tubulin acetylation, suggesting improved microtubule-dependent intracellular trafficking.

item.title: Lipid Droplet-Associated Hsp70 Palmitoylation Drives Lysosomal Dysfunction in Ischemic Stroke.
